description: Serce Pnia, the living heart of the World Tree, a huge beating heart of dark red-brown heartwood with rings of tree growth on it, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, thick root-like veins full of glowing golden sap wrapped around it like arms, two root arms with claws, glowing amber cracks, one deep glowing eye-like knot, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no tree, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
